faq.title: Everything you need to know
faq.subtitle: Straight answers about adding Rivesio to your product and working with feedback.

one.question: How do I add Rivesio to my site?
one.answer: Create a widget, copy its script tag, and paste it into your site. It loads asynchronously and does not require an SDK or backend change.

two.question: Can users attach screenshots?
two.answer: Yes. Users can capture their current screen, annotate the exact area that needs attention, or upload images with their feedback.

three.question: Can I reply to a user after they send feedback?
three.answer: Yes. Reply from the Rivesio inbox and the user sees the response in the widget. Both sides can continue the conversation in the same thread.

four.question: Can I manage feedback from multiple sites?
four.answer: Yes. Each site can use its own widget configuration while all feedback stays accessible from one workspace.

five.question: Is Rivesio free?
five.answer: Rivesio is free during beta, with all current features included and no credit card required.
